# AK Coating

> Independent guide to protective coatings in Alaska: epoxy and polyaspartic garage floors, roof coatings, spray foam insulation, log and deck stains, and rust protection.

Educational resource; not a contractor, manufacturer or retailer. Always defer to product data sheets and local codes.

## Pages

- [Protective Coatings in Alaska: Floors, Roofs, Foam, Wood and Metal](https://akcoating.com/): Overview of the coating guides and answers to common questions.
- [Epoxy vs. Polyaspartic Garage Floor Coatings for Cold Alaska Garages](https://akcoating.com/epoxy-polyaspartic-garage-floors-alaska.html): Choosing and applying a garage floor coating that survives cold slabs, slush and de-icers.
- [Roof Coatings in Alaska: What They Can and Can't Do](https://akcoating.com/roof-coatings-alaska.html): Which coatings suit low-slope and metal roofs up north, and what a coating can't fix.
- [Spray Foam Insulation Basics for Alaska Homes](https://akcoating.com/spray-foam-insulation-alaska.html): Open- vs. closed-cell foam, vapor control in climate zones 7 and 8, and safety basics.
- [Log Home and Deck Stains and Sealers for Alaska Weather](https://akcoating.com/log-home-deck-stains-sealers.html): Picking and applying stains and sealers that hold up to Alaska UV, rain and snow.
- [Metal Rust Protection in Coastal and Cold Alaska Conditions](https://akcoating.com/metal-rust-protection-alaska.html): Stopping corrosion on steel in coastal salt air and de-icer country, from prep to topcoat.
- [About AK Coating](https://akcoating.com/about.html): Who we are and how to use the guides.
- [Contact AK Coating](https://akcoating.com/contact.html): How to reach us by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://akcoating.com/privacy.html): How this site handles your information.
